name: Reverse percentages

default.aim: The original whole is 100%; a changed price is a different percentage of it.
steps: Write “original = 100%”, the stated increase or decrease, and the known final amount with its units. Leave a line beside the final amount for its percentage of the
. Keep any separate fixed charge on its own line.
For a reduction subtract the rate from 100%; for an increase add it. If a fixed charge was added after the percentage change, subtract that charge from the known bill first.
Divide the resulting percentage by 100 to form a
, then divide the known amount by it.
If the question asks for several items or batches, multiply the original amount for one by the required number.
by applying the original percentage change to your recovered amount; add back any separate fixed charge when comparing with the given bill.

whole.name: Recover the original whole
whole.when: A known amount represents a stated percentage of the original.
steps: Convert the percentage to a decimal multiplier.
Divide the known amount by the multiplier.
whole.check: Apply the original percentage change to your original amount, then restore any separate charge.

discount.name: Reverse a percentage discount
discount.when: The known price is after a percentage reduction.
steps: Divide the known item price by that decimal multiplier.
discount.check: Apply the original percentage change to your original amount, then restore any separate charge.

increase.name: Reverse a percentage increase
increase.when: The known price is after a percentage increase.
steps: Divide the known item price by that decimal multiplier.
increase.check: Apply the original percentage change to your original amount, then restore any separate charge.

charge.name: Remove a separate charge first
charge.when: A fixed charge was added after the percentage change.
steps: Subtract the fixed charge from the bill.
Reverse the percentage change using the remaining item price.
charge.check: Apply the original percentage change to your original amount, then restore any separate charge.
